companyFieldUpdates.description: Odfjell Terminals US Holdings LLC is the joint-venture parent of Odfjell's marine-connected bulk-liquid storage terminals in Houston, Texas and North Charleston, South Carolina. The platform provides tank storage and multimodal handling for chemicals, petrochemicals, oil products, biofuels, edible oils and gases through marine, barge, rail, truck and pipeline infrastructure. Northleaf acquired a 49% interest from Lindsay Goldberg on June 7, 2019 through NCP US Terminals LP; Odfjell SE retains 51% through Odfjell Terminals Americas LLC and remains the operating partner. The August 6, 2026 Delaware Chancery judgment resolved the shareholder dispute without changing ownership.
